data.long_meaning: Ishaavi is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'Goddess of Love'. In Hindu mythology, Ishavasya Upanishad refers to a Goddess named Ishani, who is considered the goddess of love and compassion. This name is believed to bring blessings of love, devotion, and purity in life. The name Ishaavi carries the meaning “Goddess of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ishaavi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Ishaavi is a Hindu female name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ishavasya', which means 'belonging to Ishvara, or God'.
